title: Xbox Series X Price Increase: UK and EU Cost Rises
description: Reports from the BBC, Engadget, and Video Games Chronicle detail significant price increases for the Xbox Series X in the UK and EU.

sections.heading: UK Price Hike
paragraphs: According to the BBC, the Xbox Series X price has been hiked by £170. The BBC attributes this increase to rising memory chip costs.

sections.heading: Regional Impact
paragraphs: Engadget reports that Xbox consoles are now much more expensive in the EU and UK. Video Games Chronicle confirms that price increases in Europe and the UK have been fully revealed.

sections.heading: European Pricing Details
paragraphs: According to Video Games Chronicle, the Xbox Series X now costs €200 more in the context of these regional price adjustments.
